purpose: Central registry for gameplay art requirements, existing assets, placeholders, and future art generation targets.

status_values.implemented: Used by current scenes, scripts, or configs.
status_values.available: Asset exists but is not wired into gameplay yet.
status_values.placeholder: Current gameplay uses a temporary or semantically imperfect asset.
status_values.missing: Required by design but no suitable asset is registered yet.

notes: Gameplay code should reference stable asset ids through this registry or domain configs.
Collision belongs to gameplay nodes, not to bitmap files.
Missing assets should use placeholders until the user explicitly asks for art generation.
Customer/random/civilian NPC walk sheets use 4 rows x 6 columns, 48x64 cells, and no duplicated standing endpoints.

Customer purchase profiles read crop preference items, demographic base budget/preferences, and personal random ranges from res://configs/customer_preferences.json, then blend demographic and per-NPC values 50/50.

generated_sprites.notes: Final generated character, item, prop, farm, location, object, and UI sprites. Intermediate generation sheets/manifests/raw files are intentionally removed.

generated_tilesets.notes: Final generated tile atlases and TileSet resources. Raw map-generation references and manifests are intentionally removed.

character.vendor.notes: Regenerated 2026-06-01 as a 1990s township middle-aged vendor. Final walk sheet is normalized to 48x64 cells, shared scale, fixed feet baseline, and exact standing loop frame. Added 2026-06-02 farming action sheets for hoeing, watering, and harvesting; player_spriteframes_48x64.tres combines walk and action animations for Player.
